question: Are temporal distinctions binding for rites performed at the Gaṅgā?
premises: All rites may be performed at the Gaṅgā.
Distinctions of time are not to be observed there.
One should act without regard to temporal divisions at that place.
inference: Therefore, rites at the Gaṅgā are to be performed without observing distinctions of time.
plain_english: One should perform everything at the Gaṅgā, and should not observe any distinction of time.
